P.name: Vow of the First Lands
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Yunara's''' {{tip|critical strike|critical strikes}} deal {{tip|critical strike|{{as|10%|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 10% per 100 AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}}}.

Q.name: Cultivation of Spirit
Q.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Yunara's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}. While this ability is inactive, her basic attacks {{tip|on-attack}} generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Unleash'' for 6 seconds, increased to 2 stacks against {{tip|champions}}. The stacks refresh on subsequent attacks, stack up to 8 times, and expire one by one every {{fd|0.5}} seconds after the duration.
Q.description2:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Yunara''' unleashes for 5 seconds: gaining {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}, dealing {{as|'''additional bonus''' magic damage|magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}, and augmenting her basic attacks to have increased missile speed, a 40% lower {{tip|attack windup|windup}} time, and an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}. Her basic attacks are also empowered to spread to each enemy near the target, dealing {{as|30% AD}} {{as|physical damage}}.
Each spread attack {{tip|applies lifesteal|applies}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} and {{tip|on-hit}} effects, with on-hit damage reduced to 30% effectiveness, and will {{tip|critically strike}} if the triggering attack does. Spread attacks deal 250% damage against {{tip|minions}} {{as|below 30% '''maximum''' health}}.
Q.description3: ''Cultivation of Spirit {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Yunara's''' basic attack timer. Targets do not have to be {{tip|sight|visible}} to be hit by the spread attacks.''

W.name: Arc of Judgment
W.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Yunara''' launches a spinning prayer bead in the target direction that briefly grants {{tip|sight}} of its {{tt|surroundings|Cannot see through terrain nor brush}} as it travels. The bead slows down significantly while colliding with an enemy, lingering as it travels and resetting its remaining duration; upon reaching maximum range, it will expand and linger in place for 1 second regardless of enemies hit.

The initial hit against each enemy before the bead's expansion deals {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 99% decaying over {{fd|1.5}} seconds. While lingering, the bead deals {{#expr:0.6*100/4}}% of the impact damage as {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies every {{fd|0.25}} seconds.
W.description2: ''Arc of Judgment'' deals {{pp|50 to 100 for 3|1;9;13|key=%}} damage against {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|execute|executes}} them if they would be killed by 6 more damage instances from the linger effect.
W.cast time: {{pp|0.45 to 0.225 for 11|0 to 100|key1=%|type='''bonus''' attack speed|label1= Bonus AS|color=attack speed|round=3}}

W.name: Arc of Ruin
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Yunara''' fires a beam of spirit magic in the target direction that deals {{pp|160 to 480 for 3|1 to 3|type=[[File:Yunara Transcend One's Self.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Transcend One's Self's'' Rank|label1=Rank|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 120% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 75% AP)}} {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 99% decaying over 1 second, as well as granting {{tip|sight}} of the {{tt|surrounding area|Cannot see through terrain nor brush}}.
W.description2: ''This ability {{tt|benefits from ultimate ability effects|See notes}} and is the upgraded version of {{ai|Arc of Judgment|Yunara}} during {{ai|Transcend One's Self|Yunara|Transcendent State}}.''
W.cast time: {{pp|0.6 to 0.45 for 11|0 to 100|key1=%|type='''bonus''' attack speed|label= Bonus AS|color=attack speed}}

E.name: Kanmei's Steps
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Yunara''' becomes {{tip|ghosted}} and gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds. The {{as|movement speed}} is 50% more effective while facing a nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy {{tip|champion}}.
E.leveling: {{st|Bonus Move Speed|{{ap|30 to 50}}%|Increased Bonus Move Speed|{{ap|30*1.5 to 50*1.5}}%}}

E.name: Untouchable Shadow
E.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Yunara''' {{tip|dashes}} in the target direction.

''Untouchable Shadow {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Yunara's''' basic attack timer. {{ai|Arc of Ruin|Yunara}} can be cast during the dash. This ability {{tt|benefits from ultimate ability effects|See notes}} and is the upgraded version of {{ai|Kanmei's Steps|Yunara}} during {{ai|Transcend One's Self|Yunara|Transcendent State}}.''

R.name: Transcend One's Self
R.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} ''{{ais|Arc of Ruin|Yunara}}'' base damage and ''{{ais|Untouchable Shadow|Yunara}}'' dash speed scale with ''Transcend One's Self's'' rank.
R.leveling:
{{st|[[File: Yunara Arc of Ruin.png|20px|border|link=]] Arc of Ruin Base Damage|{{ap|160 to 480}}}}
{{st|[[File: Yunara Untouchable Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] Untouchable Shadow Dash Speed|{{ap|1350 to 1650}}}}
R.description2:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Yunara''' enters ''Transcendent State'' for 15 seconds, during which each of her basic abilities is empowered:
{{lc|{{ai|Cultivation of Spirit|Yunara}}}} Automatically becomes active at no cost, with the duration increased to ''Transcendent State's''.
{{lc|{{ai|Arc of Judgment|Yunara}}}} Upgraded into ''{{ai|Arc of Ruin|Yunara}}'', which has no cost and has its {{sti|'''remaining''' cooldown}} reduced by 80% upon both entering and exiting the state.
{{lc|{{ai|Kanmei's Steps|Yunara}}}} Upgraded into ''{{ai|Untouchable Shadow|Yunara}}'', which has no cost and has its {{sti|cooldown}} reset upon both entering and exiting the state.
